headline: Broad growth and wider margins; next-year outlook issued
summary_short: Agilent's quarter ended Oct. 31, 2026 brought revenue of $2.04B, up 9.6% y/y (8.3% core), and non-GAAP EPS of $1.86, up 17%. FY27 revenue is guided to $8.00B-$8.15B.
summary_long: Revenue of $2,040M rose 9.6% y/y (8.3% core). Growth came in all three groups: Life Sciences and Diagnostics +12%, CrossLab +6%, Applied Markets +13%. Non-GAAP operating margin of 30.0% included about 120bp from tariff refunds. FY27 guidance: revenue $8.00B-$8.15B, non-GAAP EPS $6.73-$6.86; Q1 FY27 revenue $1.96B-$2.00B, EPS $1.54-$1.57. Cash was $1,847M; total debt $3,650M.
confidence_notes: Period label mismatch: the shard labels this event FY2026 Q3 (Yahoo), but the EX-99.1 release is Agilent's fiscal Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended Oct. 31, 2026); the shard's revenue (1,878) appears to be the prior quarter, so KPIs here come from the release, not the shard. q/q deltas are not stated in the release and are omitted. Non-GAAP figures include a $0.07 EPS net benefit from tariff refunds. Statements are labeled preliminary by the company.

drivers.explanation: Growth was broad across end markets; the CEO cites execution and the Ignite Operating System. All three business groups grew, with Applied Markets +13% and Life Sciences and Diagnostics +12%.
Margin of 30.0% includes an approximately 120bp net benefit from tariff refunds.
Net income rose to $451M from $434M, but a much higher tax provision ($67M vs $8M a year ago) held GAAP EPS growth to 4%.
